transcript: Oh, it's one day in the morning. There were two people traveling to their families, and they bump into each other at the corner of the street. When they bump into each other, um, they had, they hit their heads. After they recover from the bump, they said I'm sorry, and they took their own suitcase. and they parted their own ways. When the man got to the hotel and opened his suitcase, he realized that he had women's clothes. When the woman opened her suitcase at her hotel, she realized that she had men's clothes. What had happened is that when these two people bumped into each other at the corner of the street, they accidentally swapped their suitcases and therefore they got the wrong suitcase.
